isolation.surface: API contract endpoints + terminal/curl support only

assertions.title: Agent contract reflects prompt stack policy

steps.expected: Resolved contract system_prompt.content matches effective prompt policy
steps.observed: 200 OK and system_prompt.content exactly matched assembled_prompt

evidence.responseExcerpt: resolved.system_prompt.content begins with '<<<LAYER: global_operator_policy>>>' and equals preview.assembled_prompt

assertions.title: Role templates visible in agent contract

steps.observed: 200 OK with delegation_policy.role_templates containing role entries (e.g., implementer, scout)

evidence.responseExcerpt: roles count=6; resolved delegation_policy.role_templates count=6 and names align with /api/admin/roles

assertions.title: Delegation uses role templates for routing

steps.expected: Planner-led delegation path can execute for validation

steps.action: POST /v1/runs with a message that triggers repeated tool failure delegation
steps.expected: Run triggers delegation and role routing
Role assignment and role constraints are recorded; spawned subagent visible
steps.observed: 200 OK with role_selection records, constraint_activation containing role_allowed_tools/role_timeout_ms, and non-empty subagents[]

evidence.responseExcerpt: decision ledger includes role_selection(role=implementer), constraint_activation(role_allowed_tools=[...], role_timeout_ms=20000), and subagents[run_1773524511519465949]

assertions.title: Every delegation produces ledger entries with required fields

steps.expected: Each delegation_trigger ledger record includes trigger_reason, selected_role, task_assignment, confidence, and parent_run context
steps.observed: Mixed shapes: planned/executed delegation_trigger records include required fields, but at least one delegation_trigger record only has mode/reason/cooldown/snapshot fields and omits selected_role/task_assignment/confidence/parent_run_id

evidence.responseExcerpt: First delegation_trigger payload contains {mode, reason, cooldown_for, context_tokens...} without selected_role/task_assignment/confidence/parent_run_id

assertions.issues: Ledger schema is inconsistent for record_type=delegation_trigger; not every delegation_trigger entry includes the full required rationale/role/task/parent context fields.

assertions.title: Global config changes propagate to resolved contracts

steps.action: PATCH /api/admin/config restoring model.timeout_ms=120000 and re-check resolved contracts
steps.expected: Original value restored and propagation reversed
steps.observed: 200 OK restore; all 70 inheriting agents reverted to 120000

evidence.network: GET /api/admin/config -> 200; PATCH /api/admin/config -> 200; GET /api/admin/agents/{id}/resolved (70 inheriting ids) -> 200; PATCH /api/admin/config restore -> 200; GET resolved restored -> 200
evidence.responseExcerpt: Propagation verified across 70 inheriting agents and reverted across the same set after restore

frictions.description: Initial broad run-history query and decision scan was expensive (large /v1/runs payload) and timed out during first attempt.
frictions.resolution: Narrowed to latest run window and then validated with targeted decision retrieval plus one controlled runtime run.

summary: Tested 5 assertions: 4 passed (VAL-CROSS-001, VAL-CROSS-002, VAL-CROSS-003, VAL-CROSS-005) and 1 failed (VAL-CROSS-004 due to inconsistent delegation_trigger ledger payload fields).
